Dicen: "Tienes una pinta de párroco.

1083
00:57:19,160 --> 00:57:22,080
A veces hablas y te mueves
como si fueras un curita".

1084
00:57:22,160 --> 00:57:23,960
¿Sabes qué me llamaron ayer?

1085
00:57:25,520 --> 00:57:27,840
"Eres como mi abuelito.

1086
00:57:29,880 --> 00:57:31,560
Y yo lo quería tanto.

1087
00:57:32,080 --> 00:57:33,680
Era un hombre tan sabio".

1088
00:57:34,640 --> 00:57:38,040
Entonces, claro, ahora ya soy,
aparte de Copito de Nieve, según quién,

1089
00:57:39,440 --> 00:57:42,160
soy "el abuelo sabio".

1090
00:57:44,160 --> 00:57:46,800
Todos esos personajes, yo no los soy.

1091
00:57:47,760 --> 00:57:51,480
Ninguno, ni trotamundos ni personaje...
Yo no soy nada de eso.

1092
00:57:51,560 --> 00:57:53,600
Pero hay aspectos de mí

1093
00:57:53,680 --> 00:57:56,080
que quedan reflejados para los demás

1094
00:57:56,160 --> 00:57:57,880
de forma que los reconocen

1095
00:57:58,720 --> 00:58:00,400
como si yo fuera eso.

1096
00:58:00,920 --> 00:58:02,760
Pero la pregunta
del millón de dólares es:

1097
00:58:02,840 --> 00:58:04,040
¿pero tú eres eso?

1098
00:58:05,360 --> 00:58:07,720
Entonces, ahí es donde vamos
al templo de Delfos.

1099
00:58:07,800 --> 00:58:10,880
Ahí es donde vamos al principio
del "conócete a ti mismo".

1100
00:58:10,960 --> 00:58:15,240
Y ahí es donde Sócrates,
cuando acompaña al joven Alcibíades,

1101
00:58:15,320 --> 00:58:18,320
que quiere dedicarse a la política,
le pregunta:

1102
00:58:18,400 --> 00:58:21,200
"Usted, joven,
que quiere dedicarse a la política,

1103
00:58:21,280 --> 00:58:22,920
¿se conoce a sí mismo?

1104
00:58:23,600 --> 00:58:27,000
Porque, si se conoce,
al menos tendremos algo ya resuelto".

1105
00:58:27,800 --> 00:58:29,600
Entonces, Sócrates le dice:

1106
00:58:30,400 --> 00:58:32,000
"¿Qué significa conocerse a uno mismo?".

1107
00:58:32,080 --> 00:58:36,320
Entonces, dice:
"Igual que uno descubre el ojo

1108
00:58:37,480 --> 00:58:38,840
a través de la mirada,

1109
00:58:39,400 --> 00:58:41,840
porque mira,
y cuando se da cuenta de que no,

1110
00:58:41,920 --> 00:58:43,400
dice: 'Ah, tengo un ojo'".

1111
00:58:43,960 --> 00:58:47,640
Dice: "Nosotros reconocemos
nuestra esencia

1112
00:58:47,720 --> 00:58:51,080
cuando nos hacemos espejo,

1113
00:58:52,280 --> 00:58:55,080
cuando nuestra alma hace espejo

1114
00:58:55,160 --> 00:58:58,360
con la sabiduría y con la divinidad".

1115
00:59:00,080 --> 00:59:02,480
Entonces, ahí nos da
una clave fundamental:

1116
00:59:03,680 --> 00:59:08,120
el conocimiento de cuál es
y cómo es la realidad.

1117
00:59:08,520 --> 00:59:11,440
Y el conocimiento de la realidad
es conocer el cosmos,

1118
00:59:11,520 --> 00:59:13,080
es conocer el universo,

1119
00:59:13,160 --> 00:59:15,520
es conocer de qué está hecha la vida.

1120
00:59:15,600 --> 00:59:18,360
Entonces, yo tengo que acercarme
a esa sabiduría

1121
00:59:18,440 --> 00:59:22,240
que me ayuda a conocer
los hilos invisibles que mueven todo,

1122
00:59:23,600 --> 00:59:25,800
y eso es acercarme,
de algún modo,

1123
00:59:26,400 --> 00:59:28,920
a un conocimiento que me da sabiduría

1124
00:59:29,560 --> 00:59:30,880
y que está disponible,

1125
00:59:30,960 --> 00:59:33,040
porque ese conocimiento
lo han transmitido

1126
00:59:33,120 --> 00:59:37,040
todas las tradiciones espirituales
y religiosas del mundo.

1127
00:59:37,120 --> 00:59:39,160
Hoy lo hace la física cuántica.

1128
00:59:39,680 --> 00:59:43,480
Por lo tanto, cuando te haces de espejo
con la sabiduría,

1129
00:59:43,560 --> 00:59:45,560
aprendes cómo es la vida,

1130
00:59:45,640 --> 00:59:48,000
pero cuando te miras hacia lo divino,

1131
00:59:48,080 --> 00:59:51,240
entonces, encuentras tu alma,
te encuentras a ti.

1132
00:59:51,320 --> 00:59:53,520
Lo que estás buscando está en ti,

1133
00:59:54,480 --> 00:59:57,280
pero eso hay que encontrarlo.

1134
00:59:57,360 --> 00:59:58,960
¿Y cómo lo encuentras?

1135
00:59:59,040 --> 01:00:00,440
Cuando te vacías de ti.

1136
01:00:01,800 --> 01:00:05,920
Ese vaciarte de ti, justamente,
es quitar todas esas vueltas que le das:

1137
01:00:06,000 --> 01:00:07,680
"Si soy, si no soy,

1138
01:00:07,760 --> 01:00:10,400
si soy este personaje,
si soy aquel otro personaje,

1139
01:00:10,480 --> 01:00:12,320
si soy de esta manera, si soy de otra",

1140
01:00:12,400 --> 01:00:16,400
sino que te olvidas de eso
y te adentras en el silencio.

1141
01:00:17,600 --> 01:00:19,880
De ahí el éxito
que tiene ahora la meditación,

1142
01:00:20,760 --> 01:00:24,560
porque son caminos
que nos ayudan a ahondar,

1143
01:00:25,440 --> 01:00:29,760
a, de algún modo,
desplazar de dentro

1144
01:00:29,840 --> 01:00:33,640
esa parte que hemos identificado
como "ego" o como "yo"

1145
01:00:33,720 --> 01:00:37,960
y que, a la vez,
nos permite descubrir lo que está ahí.

1146
01:00:38,480 --> 01:00:40,760
Por lo tanto, lo que buscas, querido,

1147
01:00:41,280 --> 01:00:42,400
ya lo eres.

1148
01:00:43,920 --> 01:00:45,000
Ya lo eres.

1149
01:00:45,400 --> 01:00:48,760
Solo se trata de que vayas
a su encuentro, ¿de acuerdo?

1150
01:00:57,720 --> 01:00:59,360
Hola, Xavier, soy Adrià.

1151
01:00:59,440 --> 01:01:00,920
Muchas gracias por compartir
tu conocimiento

1152
01:01:01,000 --> 01:01:02,120
y experiencia con nosotros.

1153
01:01:02,200 --> 01:01:03,280
Gracias, Adrià.

1154
01:01:03,760 --> 01:01:06,240
Decía, con humor, Groucho Marx:

1155
01:01:06,320 --> 01:01:09,520
"Estos son mis principios
y, si no te gustan, tengo otros".

1156
01:01:10,200 --> 01:01:13,360
Y tú nos dices:
"Estas son tus creencias,

1157
01:01:13,440 --> 01:01:16,840
estos son tus sentimientos
y, si no, puedes cambiarlos".

1158
01:01:17,360 --> 01:01:21,280
Pero ¿cómo realizar cambios
tan profundos y tan enraizados en uno

1159
01:01:21,360 --> 01:01:22,320
con éxito?

1160
01:01:22,400 --> 01:01:23,200
Sí,

1161
01:01:23,560 --> 01:01:25,920
aquí hay dos cosas
que las podemos aclarar.

1162
01:01:26,000 --> 01:01:30,520
Groucho Marx hablaba
sobre el relativismo de las cosas.

1163
01:01:30,840 --> 01:01:34,720
"Si todo es relativo,
¿qué importa que creas una cosa u otra?

1164
01:01:35,040 --> 01:01:37,000
¿Qué importa
que te guste una cosa u otra?

1165
01:01:37,080 --> 01:01:39,920
¿Qué importa?
Si todo es lo mismo, si todo es igual.

1166
01:01:40,000 --> 01:01:41,960
Si es igual, tengo esto
y también tengo lo otro.

1167
01:01:42,040 --> 01:01:43,760
Tengo esto
y también tengo lo contrario".

1168
01:01:43,840 --> 01:01:47,120
Claro, eso, por supuesto,
es un relativismo que duele.

1169
01:01:47,640 --> 01:01:50,840
Las personas
nos asentamos sobre principios,

1170
01:01:51,400 --> 01:01:55,640
sobre valores
que configuran nuestro carácter

1171
01:01:55,720 --> 01:01:58,880
y que, de algún modo,
dirigen y guían nuestra vida.

1172
01:01:58,960 --> 01:02:03,360
Por eso, la tarea más importante
desde el plano de la personalidad

1173
01:02:03,440 --> 01:02:06,440
es el hacer carácter,
el hacerte a ti mismo.

1174
01:02:07,400 --> 01:02:09,640
Para hacerte a ti mismo vas a necesitar

1175
01:02:09,720 --> 01:02:14,160
construir una casa con creencias
que te sean útiles,

1176
01:02:15,040 --> 01:02:16,760
no con creencias limitantes,

1177
01:02:16,840 --> 01:02:20,720
con creencias que te den vida,
que desarrollen tus capacidades.

1178
01:02:20,800 --> 01:02:24,680
Por lo tanto,
aquello que tú estás creyendo

1179
01:02:25,040 --> 01:02:28,480
está creando
la realidad que tú vas a vivir.

1180
01:02:28,560 --> 01:02:31,040
Por eso, las creencias
son tan importantes.

1181
01:02:31,960 --> 01:02:32,880
Por lo tanto,

1182
01:02:32,960 --> 01:02:35,600
aparece aquí
un primer mensaje interesante:

1183
01:02:36,720 --> 01:02:38,280
no todas las creencias valen.

1184
01:02:39,560 --> 01:02:44,280
Valen las personas,
pero sus creencias son puntos de vista.

1185
01:02:44,880 --> 01:02:48,320
Cada persona tiene
una manera diferente de ver la realidad,

1186
01:02:48,400 --> 01:02:51,800
y es su manera,
es su realidad.

1187
01:02:52,440 --> 01:02:55,680
¿Qué es lo que nos importa?
Si esa realidad te hace feliz o no.

1188
01:02:55,760 --> 01:02:58,960
¿Qué creencias son
las que nos hacen crecer

1189
01:02:59,040 --> 01:03:01,680
y qué creencias
nos limitan nuestra existencia?

1190
01:03:02,800 --> 01:03:04,600
¿Qué certeza tienen mis creencias?

1191
01:03:05,160 --> 01:03:07,240
¿Hasta qué punto lo que yo creo

1192
01:03:07,320 --> 01:03:10,480
lo creo porque es algo
que he experimentado,

1193
01:03:10,560 --> 01:03:11,680
es algo que he vivido

1194
01:03:11,760 --> 01:03:13,720
y, por lo tanto,
he llegado a esa conclusión?

1195
01:03:13,800 --> 01:03:15,280
"Un perro me mordió:

1196
01:03:16,240 --> 01:03:17,640
los perros son peligrosos".

1197
01:03:19,320 --> 01:03:20,520
"¿Cuándo te mordió?".

1198
01:03:20,600 --> 01:03:22,240
"Cuando tenía 10 años".

1199
01:03:22,320 --> 01:03:23,920
"¿Cuántos tienes ahora?"
"60".

1200
01:03:24,640 --> 01:03:26,200
"¿Y sigues creyendo lo mismo?".

1201
01:03:26,600 --> 01:03:29,000
"Claro, los perros son peligrosos".

1202
01:03:29,960 --> 01:03:31,080
Entonces, ¿qué significa?

1203
01:03:31,480 --> 01:03:36,520
Que la experiencia me hace creer
que la creencia es cierta,

1204
01:03:37,200 --> 01:03:41,920
y me sostengo por cosas que han sido
y he vivido en el pasado,

1205
01:03:43,000 --> 01:03:46,320
pero que no me permiten
actualizarme en el presente.

1206
01:03:47,080 --> 01:03:49,320
Por lo tanto, aquello que yo creo

1207
01:03:49,840 --> 01:03:53,520
tiene que validarse
y tiene que actualizarse continuamente.

1208
01:03:54,040 --> 01:03:59,040
Eso parece que vaya en contra
de esa opinión que tiene mucha gente

1209
01:03:59,120 --> 01:04:02,080
sobre que cambiar de opinión
es una cosa de chaqueteros,

1210
01:04:02,760 --> 01:04:04,120
es una cosa que no hay que hacer.

1211
01:04:04,200 --> 01:04:07,320
"Si cambias mucho de opinión
es que tú no sabes lo que quieres".

1212
01:04:07,800 --> 01:04:09,600
¿Os acordáis de Eduard Punset,

1213
01:04:09,680 --> 01:04:13,080
el que fue ministro
y que luego fue divulgador científico?

1214
01:04:13,160 --> 01:04:15,320
Yo participé en alguno de sus programas,

1215
01:04:15,400 --> 01:04:17,320
en  Redes,  en televisión,

1216
01:04:17,400 --> 01:04:21,480
y Punset, en uno de sus libros, dijo:

1217
01:04:22,240 --> 01:04:24,520
"Muchos científicos han demostrado

1218
01:04:27,120 --> 01:04:29,280
que ser inteligente es

1219
01:04:29,800 --> 01:04:33,720
tener la capacidad de cambiar
rápidamente de opinión o de creencia

1220
01:04:33,800 --> 01:04:35,800
si te das cuenta
de que estás equivocado".

1221
01:04:37,880 --> 01:04:40,840
Es un síntoma de inteligencia

1222
01:04:41,400 --> 01:04:45,880
cambiar de opinión cuando el otro
o las circunstancias dan la razón.

1223
01:04:46,680 --> 01:04:50,920
En cambio, venimos de una cultura
de mucha obstinación,

1224
01:04:51,640 --> 01:04:54,920
que parece que nos han enseñado
que esto se graba con fuego de ley

1225
01:04:55,000 --> 01:04:56,440
y no se puede cambiar,

1226
01:04:56,520 --> 01:04:59,920
y que, si cambias,
es que tú no estás muy bien.

1227
01:05:00,800 --> 01:05:03,320
Por lo tanto, qué importancia tiene

1228
01:05:04,120 --> 01:05:08,400
el tener conciencia de qué creencias
están construyendo mi vida,

1229
01:05:08,480 --> 01:05:11,560
pero también qué creencias
tengo que cambiar de mi vida,

1230
01:05:11,640 --> 01:05:13,040
porque no me están ayudando,

1231
01:05:13,760 --> 01:05:15,280
no estoy creciendo,

1232
01:05:15,360 --> 01:05:18,400
estoy viviendo siempre lo mismo.

1233
01:05:18,480 --> 01:05:20,880
¿Y por qué siempre
estoy viviendo lo mismo?

1234
01:05:20,960 --> 01:05:22,600
Porque siempre pienso igual.

1235
01:05:22,680 --> 01:05:25,680
Antonio Blay,
que fue un gran psicólogo transpersonal,

1236
01:05:26,400 --> 01:05:29,600
decía que nosotros,
fundamentalmente, somos tres cosas,

1237
01:05:29,680 --> 01:05:32,400
inteligencia, amor y energía:

1238
01:05:33,160 --> 01:05:37,320
capacidad de pensar, capacidad de sentir
y capacidad de hacer cosas.

1239
01:05:37,400 --> 01:05:40,920
Entonces, actualizarse es,
precisamente,

1240
01:05:41,000 --> 01:05:43,760
estar actualizando
esos tres potenciales.

1241
01:05:44,800 --> 01:05:48,080
No, en cambio,
quedar atrapados en creencias.

1242
01:05:48,160 --> 01:05:51,960
Cuídate mucho de querer tener
la misma razón que los demás.

1243
01:05:52,680 --> 01:05:55,920
Descubre por ti,
actualízate continuamente

1244
01:05:56,000 --> 01:05:59,960
y sé capaz de cambiar tus creencias
y las cosas de tu vida.

1245
01:06:00,040 --> 01:06:04,560
Solo vas a encontrar un problema,
que es el que tú me detectas,

1246
01:06:04,640 --> 01:06:06,920
que es: "Cuesta mucho cambiar".

1247
01:06:07,000 --> 01:06:08,680
¿Por qué cuesta mucho cambiar?

1248
01:06:08,760 --> 01:06:11,000
Porque voy programado
de hace mucho tiempo.

1249
01:06:11,720 --> 01:06:16,040
Y estar programado de hace mucho tiempo
significa que mis redes neuronales

1250
01:06:16,120 --> 01:06:19,320
han ido construyendo ya
una serie de hábitos.

1251
01:06:19,840 --> 01:06:22,680
Y esos hábitos ya son automatizaciones,

1252
01:06:22,760 --> 01:06:25,680
de modo que, a veces,
cuando siento algo que siento,

1253
01:06:25,760 --> 01:06:28,800
me creo que lo estoy sintiendo
porque me está ocurriendo.

1254
01:06:28,880 --> 01:06:30,920
Y es verdad que te está ocurriendo,

1255
01:06:31,000 --> 01:06:33,600
pero no te está ocurriendo
por lo que está sucediendo,

1256
01:06:33,680 --> 01:06:36,080
te está ocurriendo
porque es tu programación.

1257
01:06:37,640 --> 01:06:39,240
Y ahí tenemos un problema.

1258
01:06:39,600 --> 01:06:43,800
Las emociones las sentimos en presente,
pero pertenecen al pasado.

1259
01:06:44,360 --> 01:06:48,160
Por eso, si te das cuenta,
ante las mismas situaciones,

1260
01:06:48,240 --> 01:06:51,240
sientes, piensas
y actúas de la misma manera.

1261
01:06:51,840 --> 01:06:54,520
¿Eso qué significa?
Que estás programado.

1262
01:06:55,320 --> 01:07:00,200
Entonces, una vida humana
que está viviendo en automático

1263
01:07:00,280 --> 01:07:04,160
es una vida donde no hay nada
que sea de por sí.

1264
01:07:04,240 --> 01:07:06,880
Es una vida donde tú
te has convertido en un robot.

1265
01:07:06,960 --> 01:07:08,000
¿Qué hago con eso

1266
01:07:08,080 --> 01:07:10,360
si es algo
que me impide crecer?

1267
01:07:11,320 --> 01:07:14,640
Por lo tanto,
decía un viejo sabio, Gurdjieff,

1268
01:07:14,720 --> 01:07:16,120
un maestro espiritual:

1269
01:07:17,360 --> 01:07:20,880
"Creemos que nosotros
decidimos nuestra vida

1270
01:07:20,960 --> 01:07:23,840
y que somos el director general
de lo que vivimos.

1271
01:07:24,560 --> 01:07:28,640
En realidad, somos el mayordomo
de nuestro inconsciente.

1272
01:07:29,280 --> 01:07:31,600
Por lo tanto,
todo lo que hemos automatizado,

1273
01:07:31,680 --> 01:07:34,600
todo lo que llevamos aquí,
está grabado

1274
01:07:34,680 --> 01:07:36,960
y va a aparecer,
y va a seguir apareciendo.

1275
01:07:37,040 --> 01:07:38,800
Por eso, yo siempre pido... Ya acabo.

1276
01:07:38,880 --> 01:07:39,760
Siempre pido.

1277
01:07:40,680 --> 01:07:43,120
Por favor, la primera impresión.

1278
01:07:43,720 --> 01:07:46,280
No se queden
con la primera impresión que les venga,

1279
01:07:47,000 --> 01:07:48,760
porque siempre les va a venir lo viejo,

1280
01:07:49,120 --> 01:07:52,800
siempre les va a venir lo automático,
siempre les va a venir lo de siempre.

1281
01:07:53,720 --> 01:07:56,000
Sean capaces de darse cuenta:

1282
01:07:56,080 --> 01:07:58,920
"Eso es lo viejo, pero ¿yo qué quiero?

1283
01:07:59,680 --> 01:08:01,600
¿Y yo hacia dónde quiero encauzar eso?

1284
01:08:02,000 --> 01:08:03,760
¿Y yo qué sentido quiero dar a eso?

1285
01:08:04,120 --> 01:08:08,200
Porque si no renuevo eso,
voy a vivir una vida robótica,

1286
01:08:08,280 --> 01:08:11,640
voy a ser un autómata
y solo a las puertas de la muerte

1287
01:08:11,720 --> 01:08:14,960
voy, entonces, a arrepentirme
de no haber vivido lo suficiente.

1288
01:08:20,440 --> 01:08:23,160
Hola, Xavier, encantada.
Soy Aroa.

1289
01:08:23,440 --> 01:08:25,720
Dedicas uno de tus libros
a la comunicación,

1290
01:08:25,800 --> 01:08:28,120
a ese sistema tan complejo
que hemos creado los humanos

1291
01:08:28,200 --> 01:08:29,440
para comunicarnos.

1292
01:08:30,040 --> 01:08:34,040
¿Qué ideas podrías compartir
con nosotros para entendernos mejor?

1293
01:08:34,120 --> 01:08:36,600
Probablemente lo más difícil
en este mundo

1294
01:08:36,680 --> 01:08:39,920
sea ser uno mismo
y serlo con los demás.

1295
01:08:41,080 --> 01:08:42,600
No sé si estás de acuerdo conmigo.

1296
01:08:43,120 --> 01:08:43,960
Y, sobre todo,

1297
01:08:44,760 --> 01:08:47,000
algo que tiene mucho que ver
con la comunicación,

1298
01:08:47,680 --> 01:08:49,360
que es mostrarse.

1299
01:08:51,680 --> 01:08:54,840
Seguramente, de las cosas
que más me piden en la consulta

1300
01:08:54,920 --> 01:08:58,040
es justamente ese miedo,

1301
01:08:58,520 --> 01:09:02,120
vergüenza, dificultad,
en mostrarme.

1302
01:09:02,480 --> 01:09:06,040
Y hoy que vivimos en una cultura
que es la cultura de mostrarse,

1303
01:09:06,360 --> 01:09:09,240
porque nos estamos mostrando,
es la cultura que vivimos,

1304
01:09:09,600 --> 01:09:11,920
un narcisismo,
pero galopante.

1305
01:09:12,480 --> 01:09:14,200
Pues aquí viene
una pregunta interesante:

1306
01:09:16,360 --> 01:09:18,240
¿Qué es lo que temo mostrar

1307
01:09:18,320 --> 01:09:21,240
cuando digo que temo
mostrarme a los demás?

1308
01:09:22,240 --> 01:09:23,200
Dicho de otro modo,

1309
01:09:23,280 --> 01:09:26,680
¿qué es lo que yo creo
que los demás van a ver si me muestro?

1310
01:09:28,560 --> 01:09:29,600
¿Qué me asusta tanto?

1311
01:09:29,960 --> 01:09:32,720
¿De qué tengo tanto miedo
si me muestro?

1312
01:09:33,640 --> 01:09:36,520
Entonces, generalmente,
lo que cuesta demostrarnos nosotros

1313
01:09:36,600 --> 01:09:38,280
es nuestra vulnerabilidad.

1314
01:09:38,360 --> 01:09:41,520
Hay un autor que se llama John Powell,
que escribió un libro que dice:

1315
01:09:42,240 --> 01:09:44,360
¿por qué temo decirte quién soy?

1316
01:09:45,560 --> 01:09:50,040
Y la respuesta es: "Temo decirte
quién soy porque es lo único que tengo".

1317
01:09:51,240 --> 01:09:52,120
¡Guau!

1318
01:09:53,560 --> 01:09:56,400
Entonces, si lo único que tengo
es la sensación

1319
01:09:56,480 --> 01:09:58,480
de que tengo algo
guardado dentro de mí,

1320
01:09:59,200 --> 01:10:02,280
que no quiero que sepan los demás,
porque es una cosa mía,

1321
01:10:02,360 --> 01:10:05,840
es como si los demás
tuvieran la facultad

1322
01:10:06,200 --> 01:10:09,600
de penetrar con sus ojos
dentro de mí y me vieran eso.

1323
01:10:10,480 --> 01:10:12,560
Al final,
este miedo a mostrarme

1324
01:10:13,560 --> 01:10:14,960
nos lleva a la vulnerabilidad.

1325
01:10:16,080 --> 01:10:18,880
Por tanto, fíjate que hay
una relación extraordinaria

1326
01:10:18,960 --> 01:10:22,920
entre no mostrarme quién soy
porque me daría vergüenza

1327
01:10:23,960 --> 01:10:27,640
y lo que me daría vergüenza
es que vieras lo vulnerable que soy.

1328
01:10:27,720 --> 01:10:29,520
Por lo tanto, ahí es

1329
01:10:29,600 --> 01:10:31,160
donde empezamos a interrumpir

1330
01:10:32,240 --> 01:10:35,000
lo que sería el flujo de una relación,

1331
01:10:36,000 --> 01:10:39,200
sea conmigo, sea con los demás,
sea con un grupo,

1332
01:10:39,960 --> 01:10:41,280
porque temo

1333
01:10:41,800 --> 01:10:43,200
que me ocurran estas cosas.

1334
01:10:43,600 --> 01:10:44,960
¿Qué cosas me pueden ocurrir?

1335
01:10:45,360 --> 01:10:47,840
Los tres grandes temores
de la conciencia moral,

1336
01:10:48,560 --> 01:10:52,920
los tres grandes temores
de este pequeñito

1337
01:10:53,000 --> 01:10:54,320
que tengo aquí dentro.

1338
01:10:54,400 --> 01:10:55,840
¿De qué tiene miedo?

1339
01:10:58,160 --> 01:10:59,240
De que lo avergüencen,

1340
01:11:01,120 --> 01:11:02,080
que lo culpen

1341
01:11:02,800 --> 01:11:05,200
y, sobre todo, que lo rechacen.

1342
01:11:06,520 --> 01:11:09,600
Entonces, sentir
que alguien me puede rechazar

1343
01:11:10,000 --> 01:11:13,040
es una experiencia terrible
para el ser humano.

1344
01:11:13,120 --> 01:11:16,720
Tened en cuenta que venimos
de una era tribal,

1345
01:11:16,800 --> 01:11:18,520
venimos de una evolución

1346
01:11:18,600 --> 01:11:20,960
en la que la tribu
tenía mucha fuerza,

1347
01:11:21,480 --> 01:11:25,960
y cualquier expulsado de la tribu,
cualquier persona echada de la tribu

1348
01:11:26,040 --> 01:11:27,320
era muerte segura,

1349
01:11:28,320 --> 01:11:29,760
porque no tenía la protección,

1350
01:11:30,120 --> 01:11:34,280
quedaba a expensas de los animales,
el clima, etc.

1351
01:11:35,200 --> 01:11:37,320
Por lo tanto,
hay un temor humano que es

1352
01:11:37,400 --> 01:11:38,800
el temor al rechazo,

1353
01:11:39,440 --> 01:11:43,160
y a causa de no sentirme rechazado
o temer el rechazo,

1354
01:11:43,760 --> 01:11:47,440
me encierro, no cuento,
cuento solo una parte,

1355
01:11:47,520 --> 01:11:50,000
y eso complica mucho la comunicación,

1356
01:11:50,080 --> 01:11:51,960
porque ¿qué es la comunicación?

1357
01:11:52,040 --> 01:11:55,920
Es el vehículo que me
permita que tú y yo nos podamos unir,

1358
01:11:56,840 --> 01:11:58,680
que permite que tú y yo
nos conozcamos,

1359
01:11:59,520 --> 01:12:02,280
que permite que tú y yo
podamos compartir cosas.

1360
01:12:03,720 --> 01:12:05,760
Si no hay comunicación,
no hay relación,

1361
01:12:05,840 --> 01:12:09,280
por lo tanto, la base fundamental
de la comunicación, ¿cuál es?

1362
01:12:10,600 --> 01:12:13,720
El conocimiento, por un lado,
y la relación, por otro.

1363
01:12:14,080 --> 01:12:18,840
Esas son las dos claves
que persigue toda comunicación,

1364
01:12:19,520 --> 01:12:22,400
compartir una información,
unos conocimientos,

1365
01:12:23,480 --> 01:12:28,440
pero, a la vez,
unirnos, vincularnos,

1366
01:12:29,320 --> 01:12:31,440
que haya una conexión
entre nosotros.

1367
01:12:31,520 --> 01:12:34,520
Cuando los expertos de la comunicación
se reúnen

1368
01:12:35,040 --> 01:12:37,560
en Palo Alto, en California, años 70,

1369
01:12:38,200 --> 01:12:40,640
llegan a la conclusión
de que no se puede no comunicar,

1370
01:12:41,480 --> 01:12:43,200
que, en realidad,
todo es comunicación.

1371
01:12:43,760 --> 01:12:45,960
Por lo tanto,
el problema no es la comunicación.

1372
01:12:46,040 --> 01:12:48,560
Cuando decimos: "Esa pareja tiene
un problema de comunicación",

1373
01:12:48,640 --> 01:12:50,760
"Es que a nosotros
lo que nos falta es comunicación".

1374
01:12:50,840 --> 01:12:53,480
No, no, no, comunicación
tienen siempre.

1375
01:12:54,600 --> 01:12:56,280
La comunicación existe siempre,
hagan lo que hagan,

1376
01:12:56,600 --> 01:12:57,760
aunque no se hablen.

1377
01:12:57,840 --> 01:12:59,640
Si no se hablan,
también hay comunicación.

1378
01:13:01,520 --> 01:13:03,200
El silencio es comunicación,

1379
01:13:03,840 --> 01:13:06,080
el no quererte mirar es comunicación,

1380
01:13:06,920 --> 01:13:08,120
todo es comunicación.

1381
01:13:08,200 --> 01:13:10,800
Por lo tanto, no tenemos
problemas de comunicación,

1382
01:13:10,880 --> 01:13:12,440
tenemos problemas de relación,

1383
01:13:13,440 --> 01:13:17,920
tenemos problemas de interpretar
los códigos en los que tú hablas

1384
01:13:18,000 --> 01:13:20,640
y con que tú entiendes tu mundo
y yo entiendo el mío,

1385
01:13:21,160 --> 01:13:23,520
y ahí, hablando,
la gente no se entiende,

1386
01:13:24,000 --> 01:13:26,000
no se entiende porque no es suficiente.

1387
01:13:27,040 --> 01:13:30,680
Para poderme entender,
tengo que codificar muy bien

1388
01:13:30,760 --> 01:13:32,680
como tú estás codificando tu realidad,

1389
01:13:33,440 --> 01:13:36,280
como tú piensas lo que piensas
y sientes lo que sientes,

1390
01:13:37,040 --> 01:13:38,680
Y si yo no me puedo acercar...

1391
01:13:38,760 --> 01:13:40,320
A eso llamamos "empatía".

1392
01:13:40,400 --> 01:13:43,720
Si yo no me puedo acercar a ti,
a ese conocimiento,

1393
01:13:43,800 --> 01:13:45,560
no voy a conectar contigo.

1394
01:13:47,120 --> 01:13:49,400
No es suficiente hablar
para entendernos.

1395
01:13:49,480 --> 01:13:52,680
El idioma que tenemos que hablar es el
idioma del qué hay detrás:

1396
01:13:53,320 --> 01:13:54,720
qué hay detrás de las palabras,

1397
01:13:54,800 --> 01:13:56,840
qué hay detrás
de lo que me quieres transmitir...

1398
01:13:56,920 --> 01:13:59,280
Y eso exige de mí una relación contigo,

1399
01:14:00,120 --> 01:14:03,120
y eso exige de mí un
cierto grado de empatía.

1400
01:14:03,200 --> 01:14:06,600
Utilizamos la palabra "empatía"
de una forma muy ligera.

1401
01:14:06,680 --> 01:14:08,360
"No, tenemos que ser más empáticos".

1402
01:14:08,440 --> 01:14:10,080
"Hay que ponerse en el lugar del otro".

1403
01:14:10,160 --> 01:14:12,320
Pero es que ponerse
en el lugar del otro, oigan,

1404
01:14:12,400 --> 01:14:13,600
es muy complicado,

1405
01:14:14,840 --> 01:14:16,560
y, además, exige,

1406
01:14:16,640 --> 01:14:17,880
por mi parte, silencio

1407
01:14:18,600 --> 01:14:21,920
y capacidad de adentrarme en su mundo.

1408
01:14:23,880 --> 01:14:26,520
Y cuando uno se adentra empáticamente
en el mundo del otro,

1409
01:14:26,600 --> 01:14:29,800
es cuando le puede decir:
"Si yo estuviera en tu lugar,

1410
01:14:30,440 --> 01:14:32,120
haría exactamente lo mismo que tú".

1411
01:14:33,640 --> 01:14:34,880
Eso es empatizar.

1412
01:14:36,280 --> 01:14:39,360
"Si yo estuviera en tu lugar,
sufriría como tú".

1413
01:14:40,000 --> 01:14:42,800
"Si yo estuviera en tu lugar,
pensaría como tú".

1414
01:14:43,240 --> 01:14:45,320
¿Por qué?
Porque eso es ponerme en tu lugar.

1415
01:14:45,760 --> 01:14:48,480
Otra cosa es si estoy de acuerdo,
pero no estoy de acuerdo.

1416
01:14:50,400 --> 01:14:51,920
Pero ponerme en tu lugar es eso.

1417
01:14:52,600 --> 01:14:54,040
Y ese ejercicio no lo hacemos,

1418
01:14:54,440 --> 01:14:56,720
entre otras cosas,
porque hoy tenemos mucha prisa,

1419
01:14:57,720 --> 01:15:01,560
y no atendemos a lo que llamamos
el espacio propio de la relación,

1420
01:15:01,920 --> 01:15:05,320
y no escuchamos atentamente,
y no hacemos espacio.

1421
01:15:07,040 --> 01:15:08,320
Y cuando lo hacemos,

1422
01:15:08,400 --> 01:15:12,760
tenemos que practicar
una cosa que se llama "asertividad".

1423
01:15:14,000 --> 01:15:16,400
Ser asertivos cuesta mucho,

1424
01:15:16,480 --> 01:15:19,160
por lo tanto, uno tiene que utilizar

1425
01:15:19,720 --> 01:15:22,360
ciertos instrumentos o metodologías,
que hoy tenemos muchas,

1426
01:15:22,960 --> 01:15:24,120
como la asertividad,

1427
01:15:25,040 --> 01:15:28,120
para que yo hable en primera persona
y pueda pedirte,

1428
01:15:28,200 --> 01:15:29,600
pueda decirte lo que yo necesito.

1429
01:15:30,400 --> 01:15:32,840
Lo que yo creo,
lo que yo siento.

1430
01:15:33,640 --> 01:15:35,560
Por eso, los ingleses

1431
01:15:36,440 --> 01:15:38,280
utilizan el " I " para todo:

1432
01:15:38,360 --> 01:15:43,000
" I feel, I think, I believe ".
Yo creo, yo siento, yo hago.

1433
01:15:44,080 --> 01:15:46,680
En cambio, aquí,
cuando utilizas mucho el "yo",

1434
01:15:48,000 --> 01:15:49,200
eres sospechoso.

1435
01:15:50,840 --> 01:15:52,920
"Mucho yo', mucho 'yo',
aquí mucho 'yo'".

1436
01:15:53,960 --> 01:15:57,240
¿Pero no soy yo quien siente,
y no soy yo quien habla,

1437
01:15:57,320 --> 01:15:59,080
y no soy yo quien cree,
y no soy yo...?

1438
01:15:59,160 --> 01:16:00,920
Yo tengo que hablar desde mí,

1439
01:16:01,000 --> 01:16:02,840
y tengo que hablarte en primera persona.

1440
01:16:02,920 --> 01:16:07,520
"Mira, no me gusta, me siento mal
cuando tú me niegas por la cabeza.

1441
01:16:07,600 --> 01:16:09,000
Por favor,
no me niegues,

1442
01:16:10,480 --> 01:16:11,480
te lo pido".

1443
01:16:12,160 --> 01:16:14,760
Pero yo me siento mal,
no te estoy diciendo "no me niegues".

1444
01:16:16,040 --> 01:16:17,960
Entonces, aquí también somos
muy del "tú".

1445
01:16:18,880 --> 01:16:20,600
"Porque tú,
porque tú, porque tú...",

1446
01:16:20,680 --> 01:16:21,840
la culpa siempre, el otro.

1447
01:16:22,520 --> 01:16:24,600
Entonces, no, la práctica
de la asertividad es necesaria,

1448
01:16:24,680 --> 01:16:26,160
la práctica de la empatía
es necesaria,

1449
01:16:26,240 --> 01:16:28,280
la comunicación no violenta,

1450
01:16:29,080 --> 01:16:32,880
que nos ayuda a poner la atención
en la necesidad del otro.

1451
01:16:32,960 --> 01:16:35,840
No solo en lo que piensa,
en lo que siente, sino:

1452
01:16:35,920 --> 01:16:38,400
"De acuerdo, tú lo ves de una manera,
yo lo veo de otra".

1453
01:16:39,360 --> 01:16:41,480
Pero detrás de todo lo que nosotros
nos quejamos,

1454
01:16:41,560 --> 01:16:43,760
hay alguna necesidad no cubierta.

1455
01:16:45,280 --> 01:16:48,480
Entonces, cuando hablamos,
cuando nos mostramos,

1456
01:16:48,560 --> 01:16:50,040
tenemos que ir hacia ahí,

1457
01:16:50,120 --> 01:16:53,600
hacia que yo pueda compartir contigo
lo que pienso, lo que siento

1458
01:16:54,520 --> 01:16:55,840
y lo que necesito.

1459
01:16:56,680 --> 01:16:57,760
¿Y qué espero de ti?

1460
01:16:57,840 --> 01:16:59,560
Que me acojas con empatía,

1461
01:16:59,640 --> 01:17:01,640
y que me devuelvas
también asertivamente

1462
01:17:01,720 --> 01:17:06,080
lo que tú crees,
lo que tú piensas y lo que tú necesitas.

1463
01:17:06,720 --> 01:17:09,840
Y en ese encuentro
acordamos cosas.

1464
01:17:10,600 --> 01:17:12,600
Y eso es posible
porque nos comunicamos.

1465
01:17:12,680 --> 01:17:14,040
Hay tres virus

1466
01:17:14,120 --> 01:17:16,560
que siempre van a aparecer
en una conversación,

1467
01:17:16,640 --> 01:17:18,120
sea con quien sea,

1468
01:17:19,040 --> 01:17:22,800
que son las omisiones,
las distorsiones y las generalizaciones.

1469
01:17:22,880 --> 01:17:24,240
Eso va a ocurrir siempre.

1470
01:17:25,000 --> 01:17:27,960
Tanto cuando yo estoy hablando contigo
tengo que ir con cuidado,

1471
01:17:28,040 --> 01:17:30,280
porque tú vas a cometer omisiones
y yo también.

1472
01:17:32,280 --> 01:17:33,440
¿Qué significa omitir?

1473
01:17:34,360 --> 01:17:37,240
Hay cosas que no las cuento,
pero no porque no las quiera contar,

1474
01:17:37,320 --> 01:17:38,400
sino porque no me acuerdo.

1475
01:17:39,160 --> 01:17:40,880
Simplemente porque llego a casa:

1476
01:17:40,960 --> 01:17:42,840
"¿Cómo fue la comida?".
"Muy bien".

1477
01:17:43,200 --> 01:17:44,960
"¿Os lo pasasteis bien?".
"Sí".

1478
01:17:45,040 --> 01:17:48,880
También vamos a distorsionar cosas,
entonces vienen las presuposiciones:

1479
01:17:48,960 --> 01:17:51,840
"No, yo presupongo
que lo que tú me querías decir...",

1480
01:17:51,920 --> 01:17:54,600
"Te he entendido mal
porque yo creía que tú querías".

1481
01:17:56,480 --> 01:17:59,240
Los malentendidos
siempre vienen por presuposiciones.

1482
01:17:59,840 --> 01:18:02,840
Presuponer no ayuda,
tampoco ayuda a generalizar:

1483
01:18:03,200 --> 01:18:04,680
"Es que todos los hombres son iguales",

1484
01:18:04,760 --> 01:18:06,720
"Es que tú siempre,
tú siempre".

1485
01:18:08,160 --> 01:18:09,760
"No, yo nunca, nunca".

1486
01:18:09,840 --> 01:18:12,320
Entonces, "nunca", "siempre",
"todos", "todas"...

1487
01:18:12,400 --> 01:18:14,760
Hay que ir con cuidado,
porque esos lenguajes

1488
01:18:15,160 --> 01:18:17,320
son una comunicación complicada.

1489
01:18:17,400 --> 01:18:19,240
Por lo tanto, "¡Guau!,

1490
01:18:19,320 --> 01:18:22,520
qué difícil es
relacionarme con los demás,

1491
01:18:22,920 --> 01:18:26,240
qué fácil sería si la vida fuera
que yo hago lo que quiero,

1492
01:18:26,560 --> 01:18:30,280
qué fácil sería si yo condujera solo,
porque los demás son una molestia,

1493
01:18:30,360 --> 01:18:33,000
todos conducen mal,
todos lo hacen fatal,

1494
01:18:33,080 --> 01:18:35,480
todos se cruzan
cuando no se tienen que cruzar".

1495
01:18:35,560 --> 01:18:38,200
"Qué bien me lo pasaría yo solito",

1496
01:18:38,520 --> 01:18:41,400
pero cuando pasaran cuatro días diría:
"Qué solo que estoy,

1497
01:18:42,880 --> 01:18:44,080
te echo en falta,

1498
01:18:44,640 --> 01:18:46,360
me gustaría que estuvieras aquí".

1499
01:18:46,440 --> 01:18:49,680
Por lo tanto,
ya necesitamos la relación,

1500
01:18:50,040 --> 01:18:52,640
y para relacionarnos bien
necesitamos la comunicación,

1501
01:18:52,720 --> 01:18:55,440
y para comunicarnos bien
tenemos que podernos mostrar

1502
01:18:55,520 --> 01:18:56,440
tal como somos.

1503
01:18:56,960 --> 01:18:58,560
Ahí tenéis todo el juego, ¿vale?

1504
01:19:08,520 --> 01:19:10,040
Hola, Xavier, soy Almudena.

1505
01:19:10,840 --> 01:19:14,400
En esto de las relaciones
cada vez estoy notando

1506
01:19:14,480 --> 01:19:18,040
que tengo menos conversaciones
con gente a la que quiero.

1507
01:19:18,440 --> 01:19:20,560
Amigos que antes
me llamaban por teléfono,

1508
01:19:20,640 --> 01:19:22,960
ahora solamente envían memes.

1509
01:19:24,440 --> 01:19:25,760
También me he dado cuenta

1510
01:19:25,840 --> 01:19:28,760
de que, en mi propia casa,
mis hijos a veces me escriben WhatsApps

1511
01:19:28,840 --> 01:19:31,080
desde sus cuartos
para preguntarme algo.

1512
01:19:31,960 --> 01:19:36,720
¿Cómo podemos hacer
para enamorarnos de la palabra otra vez?

1513
01:19:37,240 --> 01:19:39,480
Cuando yo escribí el libro
sobre la comunicación...

1514
01:19:40,080 --> 01:19:41,800
De este libro hace 20 años.

1515
01:19:42,920 --> 01:19:45,360
Mira, Almudena,
no me habría imaginado nunca

1516
01:19:46,200 --> 01:19:47,600
que al cabo de 20 años

1517
01:19:48,360 --> 01:19:49,760
tendría que estar hablando de esto.

1518
01:19:49,840 --> 01:19:52,520
Yo creí que las cosas irían a mejor,

1519
01:19:52,600 --> 01:19:55,440
que seríamos más diestros
en el arte de la comunicación,

1520
01:19:55,520 --> 01:19:59,160
las relaciones, que habríamos aprendido
de la inteligencia emocional,

1521
01:19:59,240 --> 01:20:03,280
que seríamos ya personas que habríamos
entendido perfectamente

1522
01:20:03,360 --> 01:20:04,840
qué es ser humano.

1523
01:20:05,880 --> 01:20:09,520
No me hubiera imaginado
que tuviera que reescribir el libro

1524
01:20:09,960 --> 01:20:11,800
y tuviera que contar
lo que estoy contando ahora,

1525
01:20:13,000 --> 01:20:16,240
que es que puede ser
incluso una invasión

1526
01:20:16,320 --> 01:20:17,720
que te llamen por teléfono.

1527
01:20:18,760 --> 01:20:20,560
Hoy es de mal gusto,

1528
01:20:21,000 --> 01:20:23,480
es de mala educación
llamar por teléfono,

1529
01:20:24,360 --> 01:20:27,000
porque es una interrupción.
"Oye, ¿por qué me llamas?

1530
01:20:28,640 --> 01:20:30,560
Yo estoy en mi mundo,
estoy en mis cosas,

1531
01:20:30,640 --> 01:20:32,200
estoy haciendo...
¿Por qué me llamas?

1532
01:20:32,280 --> 01:20:33,600
Mándame un mensaje".

1533
01:20:35,480 --> 01:20:39,120
Entonces, eso se traduce luego

1534
01:20:39,720 --> 01:20:42,240
en que muchas generaciones actuales

1535
01:20:44,720 --> 01:20:46,880
temen situaciones presenciales.

1536
01:20:48,360 --> 01:20:50,840
El otro día me lo decía
una panadera, dice:

1537
01:20:50,920 --> 01:20:53,800
"Los chicos jóvenes
no vienen a comprar pan,

1538
01:20:55,840 --> 01:20:57,800
porque no saben qué pedir,
no saben qué tienen que hacer".

1539
01:20:58,760 --> 01:21:01,240
Es una situación social que no la viven.

1540
01:21:02,720 --> 01:21:07,040
¿Por qué no nos afrontamos,
por qué no hay presencialidad?

1541
01:21:07,400 --> 01:21:09,840
¿Por qué no somos capaces
de ir a lugares públicos

1542
01:21:09,920 --> 01:21:11,600
y hacer cosas con gente?

1543
01:21:12,400 --> 01:21:13,720
Porque nos frustramos.

1544
01:21:15,160 --> 01:21:16,720
¿Y qué es lo que se frustra?

1545
01:21:17,560 --> 01:21:19,160
Pues lo que queremos hacer nosotros.

1546
01:21:20,880 --> 01:21:21,720
¿Qué se frustra?

1547
01:21:21,800 --> 01:21:23,960
El darme cuenta
de que me faltan herramientas.

1548
01:21:24,800 --> 01:21:27,360
¿Qué se frustra?
El vivir cosas que no quiero vivir.

1549
01:21:28,320 --> 01:21:29,840
Entonces, estamos ante una sociedad

1550
01:21:31,000 --> 01:21:33,160
que yo la llamaría
casi "la sociedad de la frustración".

1551
01:21:34,320 --> 01:21:38,720
Frustración en este sentido, entendida
como baja tolerancia a la frustración.

1552
01:21:41,520 --> 01:21:44,360
Por nada ya me agobio,

1553
01:21:45,160 --> 01:21:46,400
por nada me frustro,

1554
01:21:47,480 --> 01:21:50,320
por nada,
si las cosas no son como yo quiero,

1555
01:21:50,800 --> 01:21:52,120
ya me pongo tenso.

1556
01:21:52,680 --> 01:21:56,280
Si las cosas no son como yo quiero,
incluso me pongo agresivo.

1557
01:21:56,360 --> 01:21:57,920
Estamos asistiendo

1558
01:21:58,400 --> 01:22:01,560
a muchas situaciones sociales
en las que hay agresividad.

1559
01:22:02,360 --> 01:22:05,360
Agresividad contra los profesores,
agresividad contra los médicos,

1560
01:22:05,440 --> 01:22:08,280
hay mucha agresividad,
y dices: "¿Y de dónde nace eso?".

1561
01:22:08,360 --> 01:22:10,560
Porque la gente no soporta,

1562
01:22:11,600 --> 01:22:13,720
no soporta esperar,

1563
01:22:13,800 --> 01:22:15,640
no soporta
que le digan no sé qué a su hijo,

1564
01:22:15,720 --> 01:22:19,320
no soporta ciertas condiciones,
no lo soportan.

1565
01:22:19,400 --> 01:22:22,600
No soportar significa
baja tolerancia a la frustración.

1566
01:22:24,720 --> 01:22:28,720
Y la respuesta
es una respuesta tensa, agresiva.

1567
01:22:29,720 --> 01:22:32,000
Entonces, ahí tenemos que hacer
un replanteamiento,

1568
01:22:32,080 --> 01:22:34,280
yo creo que necesario,

1569
01:22:35,120 --> 01:22:37,800
de recuperar
la capacidad de presencialidad.

1570
01:22:38,640 --> 01:22:41,360
Que salgamos de la frustración,

1571
01:22:41,440 --> 01:22:44,640
que salgamos de ese mundo encerrado
de la maquinita,

1572
01:22:45,520 --> 01:22:48,120
y nos permitamos
volver al contacto,

1573
01:22:48,760 --> 01:22:51,640
volver a lo que es esencial
en el ser humano,

1574
01:22:52,040 --> 01:22:53,360
que siempre ha sido eso,

1575
01:22:54,640 --> 01:22:58,400
estar juntos,
y juntos aprendemos.

1576
01:22:59,880 --> 01:23:03,000
Miren, si después de todo
lo que les he dicho

1577
01:23:03,080 --> 01:23:04,280
durante todo este tiempo,

1578
01:23:04,840 --> 01:23:07,400
aún consideran
que necesitan una ayudita,

1579
01:23:08,120 --> 01:23:10,120
vayan a un profesional de la psicología.

1580
01:23:12,400 --> 01:23:15,680
Nuestra tarea hoy es monumental,

1581
01:23:16,480 --> 01:23:18,200
tenemos mucho trabajo.

1582
01:23:19,080 --> 01:23:20,680
Desde la pandemia hacia aquí,

1583
01:23:21,800 --> 01:23:25,560
las personas han descubierto
que la vida que llevaban

1584
01:23:25,640 --> 01:23:28,480
distraída, atareada,

1585
01:23:29,960 --> 01:23:32,880
tapaba muchas cosas
que estaban sufriendo.

1586
01:23:34,240 --> 01:23:37,080
Les digo esto
porque parte de mi trabajo,

1587
01:23:37,160 --> 01:23:38,560
y con eso ya termino,

1588
01:23:39,160 --> 01:23:44,680
ha consistido en investigar qué es
lo que crea el sufrimiento humano.

1589
01:23:45,280 --> 01:23:48,000
Vivimos una parte de nuestra vida
sin saber quién somos,

1590
01:23:49,480 --> 01:23:53,200
vivimos otra parte de nuestra vida
que no nos gusta cómo somos,

1591
01:23:53,840 --> 01:23:56,360
y cuando ya empezamos a entender
qué es la vida,

1592
01:23:57,200 --> 01:23:58,960
entonces tenemos la vida funcional:

1593
01:23:59,040 --> 01:24:02,080
tenemos que casarnos,
tener hijos, tenemos que trabajar,

1594
01:24:02,160 --> 01:24:05,720
tenemos que desarrollarnos
intelectualmente, profesionalmente...

1595
01:24:05,800 --> 01:24:08,800
con lo cual alcanzamos
nuestro mérito mayor

1596
01:24:08,880 --> 01:24:11,960
en la parte que es la parte funcional.

1597
01:24:13,680 --> 01:24:16,400
Pero entonces llega
la etapa crítica,

1598
01:24:17,240 --> 01:24:21,680
la etapa donde lo inconsciente,
lo reprimido,

1599
01:24:21,760 --> 01:24:25,440
nuestras sombras,
sobre todo, todo aquello que soy,

1600
01:24:26,640 --> 01:24:28,200
pero que dejé en el tintero,

1601
01:24:28,520 --> 01:24:31,560
todo aquello que soy,
pero abandoné por hacer otra cosa,

1602
01:24:31,640 --> 01:24:34,240
por quedar bien,
por dar el gusto a la familia,

1603
01:24:34,800 --> 01:24:36,520
por ser como todo el mundo...

1604
01:24:37,440 --> 01:24:41,200
Eso que yo dejé,
eso que yo ya traía en mí,

1605
01:24:42,320 --> 01:24:45,120
a media edad,
entre los 40 y los 50,

1606
01:24:48,000 --> 01:24:49,080
llama la puerta,

1607
01:24:50,720 --> 01:24:52,560
y exige su derecho a ser.

1608
01:24:53,800 --> 01:24:55,480
Y entonces
es cuando nos vienen las crisis,

1609
01:24:56,640 --> 01:24:58,040
antes se llamaba
"la crisis de los 40",

1610
01:24:58,120 --> 01:25:00,200
hoy ya no sabemos dónde ponerlo,

1611
01:25:01,320 --> 01:25:02,960
ya no sabemos dónde ponerlo,

1612
01:25:03,960 --> 01:25:08,440
pero nos viene una crisis que significa:
Todo aquello que yo creí que era,

1613
01:25:08,720 --> 01:25:12,400
resulta que no estoy cómodo siendo así,

1614
01:25:12,920 --> 01:25:16,040
pero además hay otros aspectos
que a mí me gustaría desarrollar,

1615
01:25:17,320 --> 01:25:18,720
que no he desarrollado en mí.

1616
01:25:19,320 --> 01:25:22,000
Y luego también me doy cuenta
de la defraudación

1617
01:25:22,080 --> 01:25:23,960
de haber sido un niño o una niña buena,

1618
01:25:24,480 --> 01:25:28,160
de que tarde y mal entendí

1619
01:25:28,760 --> 01:25:30,800
que por querer
que todo el mundo me quisiera,

1620
01:25:30,880 --> 01:25:33,680
lo único que conseguí
es que todo el mundo me utilizara.

1621
01:25:35,080 --> 01:25:37,320
Por lo tanto,
cuando llego a esa desazón,

1622
01:25:37,400 --> 01:25:40,000
cuando llego a esa crisis,
cuando llega ese momento

1623
01:25:40,480 --> 01:25:42,440
en que la vida me pide que sea más yo,

1624
01:25:42,920 --> 01:25:44,560
entonces tengo que dejarme ayudar.

1625
01:25:45,160 --> 01:25:47,000
Hay gente que esto lo resuelve mal.

1626
01:25:48,240 --> 01:25:50,280
"Ya me cansé, esto ya no me interesa,

1627
01:25:50,360 --> 01:25:52,120
ahora voy a ser
todo lo que no he sido",

1628
01:25:52,200 --> 01:25:53,840
entonces se convierten en otra figura,

1629
01:25:55,160 --> 01:25:56,800
pero eso tampoco es la solución,

1630
01:25:57,200 --> 01:25:58,520
porque entonces haces locuras,

1631
01:25:59,120 --> 01:26:00,520
locuras que no hacen falta.

1632
01:26:01,720 --> 01:26:04,080
Todo consiste en que podamos integrar

1633
01:26:04,640 --> 01:26:07,840
estas dos partes,
esa dualidad que existe en nosotros,

1634
01:26:08,320 --> 01:26:11,160
la parte que hemos desarrollado
y la parte que no,

1635
01:26:11,240 --> 01:26:12,760
tienen que poderse integrar.

1636
01:26:13,440 --> 01:26:14,720
Como dijo Carl Jung:

1637
01:26:14,800 --> 01:26:19,080
"Dentro de un mandala,
que tiene un centro en el corazón

1638
01:26:19,160 --> 01:26:21,760
y que ese corazón
hace que todo se integre,

1639
01:26:22,080 --> 01:26:25,680
porque todo lo que queda desechado,
todo lo que no queda integrado,

1640
01:26:25,760 --> 01:26:28,440
va a ser reprimido,
y lo reprimido va a ser proyectado,

1641
01:26:28,520 --> 01:26:30,440
y de ahí aparecen las sombras".

1642
01:26:32,480 --> 01:26:34,880
Por lo tanto, para hacer ese ejercicio,

1643
01:26:35,920 --> 01:26:39,400
es necesario acudir a veces
a profesionales de la salud,

1644
01:26:39,880 --> 01:26:42,000
en este caso,
en concreto, de la psicología.

1645
01:26:42,320 --> 01:26:44,320
Les vamos a ayudar en estos aspectos

1646
01:26:44,400 --> 01:26:48,240
que tienen que ver con las crisis
propias de nuestra vida,

1647
01:26:48,320 --> 01:26:49,560
ansiedad, depresiones,

1648
01:26:50,520 --> 01:26:53,080
dificultades en el trabajo,
adaptarse,

1649
01:26:54,160 --> 01:26:55,280
problemas de pareja...

1650
01:26:55,360 --> 01:26:57,680
En fin, hay una serie de problemáticas
que son eternas

1651
01:26:57,760 --> 01:26:59,120
en el mundo de la psicología,

1652
01:26:59,200 --> 01:27:01,720
que siguen estando ahí
y ahí estamos para facilitar.

1653
01:27:02,680 --> 01:27:04,560
Pero descubrí con mi colega

1654
01:27:04,640 --> 01:27:06,600
en la consulta, Nuria Molina,

1655
01:27:06,920 --> 01:27:11,240
descubrí que había otra cosa
que causaba mucho dolor y sufrimiento,

1656
01:27:11,680 --> 01:27:13,480
y es que contamos el tiempo.

1657
01:27:15,920 --> 01:27:18,400
Vivir contando el tiempo
es doloroso,

1658
01:27:19,280 --> 01:27:21,240
porque uno va viendo
que pasa el tiempo

1659
01:27:21,600 --> 01:27:23,760
y todavía no ha resuelto muchas cosas.

1660
01:27:24,400 --> 01:27:27,280
Pasa el tiempo y todavía no soy
el que pensaba ser,

1661
01:27:27,960 --> 01:27:31,040
pasa el tiempo y todavía no he logrado
aquel propósito que me hice,

1662
01:27:31,520 --> 01:27:33,480
pasa el tiempo y aún no soy rico,

1663
01:27:33,880 --> 01:27:35,720
pasa el tiempo y aún no soy feliz,

1664
01:27:36,240 --> 01:27:38,720
pasa el tiempo
y cada vez me desespero más

1665
01:27:39,280 --> 01:27:41,080
porque voy viendo que el tiempo pasa.

1666
01:27:42,040 --> 01:27:44,400
Entonces, el que calcula
y el que va contando el tiempo

1667
01:27:44,480 --> 01:27:45,280
se desespera.

1668
01:27:46,280 --> 01:27:50,880
Por tanto, un gran generador de angustia
en la vida de las personas es el tiempo.

1669
01:27:51,600 --> 01:27:56,480
Por tanto, piensen, observen
cómo tratan el tiempo en su vida.

1670
01:27:57,000 --> 01:28:02,040
El tiempo no es el cronómetro,
no es el tiempo cronológico,

1671
01:28:02,640 --> 01:28:05,400
tampoco es el tiempo lineal
que vivimos en Occidente:

1672
01:28:05,800 --> 01:28:07,560
nacemos, vivimos y morimos.

1673
01:28:09,720 --> 01:28:12,240
"El tiempo es la naturaleza
de la que hemos sido creados",

1674
01:28:12,320 --> 01:28:13,280
decía el poeta.

1675
01:28:15,560 --> 01:28:20,560
"El tiempo", decía Heidegger, filósofo,
"y el ser es lo mismo".

1676
01:28:21,280 --> 01:28:23,680
¿Qué soy?
Tiempo de existencia.

1677
01:28:24,600 --> 01:28:25,840
¿Qué soy? Tiempo.

1678
01:28:26,640 --> 01:28:29,120
Por tanto, una cosa es lo que soy,
tiempo,

1679
01:28:29,400 --> 01:28:31,600
la otra es lo que hago
con ese tiempo que soy.

1680
01:28:32,000 --> 01:28:33,080
¿Qué hago con mi vida?

1681
01:28:33,160 --> 01:28:35,920
¿La dedico
a pasarme el día viendo series?

1682
01:28:36,320 --> 01:28:37,800
Pues la dedico a ver series,

1683
01:28:38,840 --> 01:28:40,120
pero luego no te quejes.

1684
01:28:40,960 --> 01:28:43,160
Luego no me vengas y digas:
"He perdido el tiempo".

1685
01:28:43,640 --> 01:28:45,280
No, no, no has perdido el tiempo.

1686
01:28:46,480 --> 01:28:49,160
¿Cuánta gente,
después de un divorcio, una separación:

1687
01:28:49,240 --> 01:28:52,880
"Es que he perdido el tiempo,
ha estafado parte de mi vida."?

1688
01:28:52,960 --> 01:28:55,200
No, no, tú has dedicado
parte de tu vida a eso.

1689
01:28:55,600 --> 01:28:57,160
Lo que eres
lo has dedicado a eso.

1690
01:28:57,600 --> 01:29:00,640
¿Ya está? ¿Has visto que no?
Dedícalo a otra cosa, perfecto.

1691
01:29:01,800 --> 01:29:03,400
¿Pero qué significa
"me han estafado"?

1692
01:29:03,480 --> 01:29:05,080
¿Qué significa
"he perdido el tiempo"?

1693
01:29:05,160 --> 01:29:08,400
No, no, tú siempre eres tiempo,
tú estás en el tiempo siempre,

1694
01:29:08,760 --> 01:29:09,920
eres tiempo.

1695
01:29:10,280 --> 01:29:11,840
Por lo tanto, decide

1696
01:29:11,920 --> 01:29:13,320
qué hacer con el tiempo que eres.

1697
01:29:13,400 --> 01:29:15,800
Muchas gracias,
bendiciones para todos.

makes

00:01:50,200 --> 00:01:55,400

37
00:01:55,480 --> 00:01:57,160

00:01:57,240 --> 00:01:59,880

00:02:15,680 --> 00:02:17,320

00:02:17,400 --> 00:02:22,480

00:02:22,560 --> 00:02:26,680

00:02:26,760 --> 00:02:28,280

00:02:28,360 --> 00:02:31,680

fear becomes associated with other things

00:02:31,760 --> 00:02:35,800

panic... starts to happen,

With this anxiety thing, it

00:03:05,720 --> 00:03:07,640

Fear sticks

00:03:07,720 --> 00:03:10,600

around what is truly dangerous.

00:03:10,680 --> 00:03:15,000

63
00:03:15,080 --> 00:03:17,040

64
00:03:17,120 --> 00:03:18,000

65
00:03:18,080 --> 00:03:20,440

that could happen

66
00:03:20,520 --> 00:03:23,800

you get anxious as if they were inevitable

67
00:03:23,880 --> 00:03:25,800

68
00:03:25,880 --> 00:03:28,680
Then, there's a ladder,

69
00:03:28,760 --> 00:03:31,080

70
00:03:31,480 --> 00:03:32,480

71
00:03:32,560 --> 00:03:35,560

72
00:03:35,640 --> 00:03:38,480

00:04:07,680 --> 00:04:09,640

00:04:28,880 --> 00:04:33,240

00:04:51,160 --> 00:04:52,480

00:04:57,800 --> 00:05:01,800

102
00:05:01,880 --> 00:05:04,560

00:05:04,640 --> 00:05:06,280

00:05:06,360 --> 00:05:08,720

00:05:08,800 --> 00:05:09,800

108
00:05:17,080 --> 00:05:19,320

00:05:19,880 --> 00:05:21,040

00:05:21,120 --> 00:05:24,680
If something has been dangerous, you say:

00:05:25,080 --> 00:05:29,320

But if one day I have to take the car,

00:05:43,960 --> 00:05:46,440

120
00:05:46,520 --> 00:05:48,800

121
00:05:49,320 --> 00:05:50,520

122
00:05:51,040 --> 00:05:53,680
Then, some of the therapies

00:05:53,760 --> 00:05:55,880

124
00:05:56,880 --> 00:05:59,720
Sometimes, to get out of a maze,

00:06:00,080 --> 00:06:03,960

00:06:04,040 --> 00:06:06,680

00:06:06,760 --> 00:06:08,640

00:06:08,720 --> 00:06:11,520

00:06:11,600 --> 00:06:15,800
and are so scared, it's

00:06:15,880 --> 00:06:20,040

131
00:06:21,000 --> 00:06:24,320

132
00:06:24,960 --> 00:06:27,960

133
00:06:28,040 --> 00:06:29,760

134
00:06:29,840 --> 00:06:32,960

135
00:06:33,400 --> 00:06:35,840
Sometimes, the past is hard

136
00:06:35,920 --> 00:06:39,400

137
00:06:39,480 --> 00:06:43,080
We say,
"I'm moving forward and this has already happened,"

138
00:06:43,440 --> 00:06:45,280

139
00:06:45,360 --> 00:06:48,240
But, really,
if the things that have happened

140
00:06:48,320 --> 00:06:50,520

141
00:06:50,600 --> 00:06:53,520

142
00:06:54,040 --> 00:06:57,800
And these memories can influence us now

143
00:06:57,880 --> 00:07:01,240
I may be having a problem

144
00:07:02,320 --> 00:07:04,960

I have had a similar experience

145
00:07:05,040 --> 00:07:08,280

146
00:07:08,560 --> 00:07:10,640

147
00:07:11,440 --> 00:07:13,440
Then, when this happens,

148
00:07:13,520 --> 00:07:15,800
we have to go back

149
00:07:15,880 --> 00:07:17,560
because, if we don't untie this knot,

150
00:07:17,640 --> 00:07:21,080
everything that happens
afterwards will get stuck too.

151
00:07:21,800 --> 00:07:25,680
I work a lot with EMDR,

152
00:07:25,760 --> 00:07:26,960
and in it what is done

153
00:07:27,040 --> 00:07:29,680

154
00:07:29,760 --> 00:07:31,760
I have a problem now.  I

155
00:07:32,720 --> 00:07:35,480

156
00:07:35,920 --> 00:07:39,680
Then,
we will look for what this is connected to.

157
00:07:39,760 --> 00:07:43,400
The problem I have
is that I always end up in relationships

158
00:07:43,480 --> 00:07:46,040
where I have to do what the other person wants,

159
00:07:46,120 --> 00:07:50,240
and I, in the end,

160
00:07:51,480 --> 00:07:53,440
We will go to the first relationships,

161
00:07:53,520 --> 00:07:56,360

162
00:07:56,880 --> 00:07:58,880
And then also to the first bonds,

163
00:07:58,960 --> 00:08:01,560

164
00:08:01,640 --> 00:08:04,440

165
00:08:04,920 --> 00:08:07,400
My parents may have

166
00:08:07,480 --> 00:08:10,640

167
00:08:10,720 --> 00:08:14,760

168

169
00:08:16,800 --> 00:08:17,880

170
00:08:18,320 --> 00:08:22,000
So I got used

171
00:08:22,080 --> 00:08:23,880

172
00:08:23,960 --> 00:08:26,120

173
00:08:26,720 --> 00:08:28,440

00:08:28,520 --> 00:08:31,880

00:08:31,960 --> 00:08:35,240

177

180
00:08:48,720 --> 00:08:52,920

181
00:08:53,000 --> 00:08:57,760

182

of course, it

185
00:09:05,280 --> 00:09:07,240

188

189
00:09:17,320 --> 00:09:18,880

190
00:09:18,960 --> 00:09:21,600
what I will notice when I return to the memory

191
00:09:22,240 --> 00:09:25,760

192
00:09:26,480 --> 00:09:28,880
And after a while,

193
00:09:29,280 --> 00:09:30,960

194
00:09:31,040 --> 00:09:33,480

195
00:09:33,840 --> 00:09:35,720
When something

196
00:09:35,800 --> 00:09:39,400

197
00:09:39,480 --> 00:09:41,800

198
00:09:41,880 --> 00:09:45,080

199
00:09:45,960 --> 00:09:49,800
Most of the time

200
00:09:49,880 --> 00:09:52,480
Then,
when working on memories,

201
00:09:52,560 --> 00:09:57,000
both of things that happened

202
00:09:57,080 --> 00:09:59,880
because, perhaps, I had the problem

203
00:09:59,960 --> 00:10:02,760

00:10:02,840 --> 00:10:05,680

00:10:05,760 --> 00:10:09,600

206
00:10:09,920 --> 00:10:15,080
In this way,

207
00:10:15,480 --> 00:10:17,120
from all the experiences

208
00:10:17,200 --> 00:10:19,240
that have to do

00:10:19,320 --> 00:10:20,360

00:10:20,440 --> 00:10:24,240

00:10:24,960 --> 00:10:30,320

00:10:30,640 --> 00:10:34,480
Therefore, an exercise

213
00:10:34,560 --> 00:10:35,640

00:10:35,720 --> 00:10:39,000

215
00:10:39,080 --> 00:10:41,320

00:10:42,280 --> 00:10:44,440

217
00:10:44,880 --> 00:10:48,080
And the second question would be:

218
00:10:48,160 --> 00:10:51,960
But it's not that I care much about it,

219
00:10:52,520 --> 00:10:55,200

220
00:10:55,280 --> 00:10:58,880

00:10:58,960 --> 00:11:02,960
This would be an example of a memory

222
00:11:03,640 --> 00:11:08,840
And, by working on this memory, we

223
00:11:09,600 --> 00:11:11,720
So now I could put myself

224
00:11:12,000 --> 00:11:13,920

00:11:17,320 --> 00:11:19,880

00:11:19,960 --> 00:11:21,240

00:11:23,280 --> 00:11:25,800

00:11:26,520 --> 00:11:28,960

00:11:29,240 --> 00:11:30,800

00:11:30,880 --> 00:11:33,000

n't think is that big of a deal.

00:11:33,080 --> 00:11:34,600

00:11:44,280 --> 00:11:48,400

not proportionate to this.

238
00:11:48,480 --> 00:11:51,840
So, trauma therapies
work a bit like this.

00:11:52,360 --> 00:11:55,800
In a way,
this is likeresetting yourbrain.

00:11:56,360 --> 00:12:00,160
We have fears that are stuck,

00:12:00,440 --> 00:12:02,640

00:12:02,720 --> 00:12:06,120

243
00:12:06,200 --> 00:12:06,880

00:12:07,160 --> 00:12:11,520

245
00:12:11,880 --> 00:12:15,880

00:12:16,320 --> 00:12:20,480

00:12:28,440 --> 00:12:30,240

00:12:30,320 --> 00:12:33,200
Just as there are things

00:12:33,280 --> 00:12:35,800

now, with the passage of time, they

00:12:35,880 --> 00:12:38,880

253
00:12:38,960 --> 00:12:41,200
When this doesn't happen with a memory,

00:12:41,280 --> 00:12:44,320

255
00:12:45,080 --> 00:12:47,400
And this is
one of the things we can do.  It

00:12:47,480 --> 00:12:50,800

257
00:12:50,880 --> 00:12:52,800
listen to other perspectives...

258
00:12:52,880 --> 00:12:56,800
But, in my experience,
EMDR works even with things

259
00:12:56,880 --> 00:12:59,520
that we have talked about, that we have thought about
,

260
00:12:59,600 --> 00:13:03,880
but this blockage is on a
more emotional, deeper level,

261
00:13:04,320 --> 00:13:07,200
and this unlocks it
in a different way.

262
00:13:08,400 --> 00:13:10,560
When we also talked about avoidance,

263
00:13:11,320 --> 00:13:15,160

264
00:13:15,240 --> 00:13:18,240
For example, what

265
00:13:18,560 --> 00:13:21,960
this scares me,
and instead of avoiding it

00:13:22,040 --> 00:13:24,640

00:13:24,720 --> 00:13:25,600

00:13:26,080 --> 00:13:29,320

269
00:13:29,640 --> 00:13:32,880

270
00:13:33,400 --> 00:13:35,440
It's like, "I'm afraid of the car.

00:13:35,520 --> 00:13:38,400

00:13:38,480 --> 00:13:39,840
This is how fear can go away.

273
00:13:40,720 --> 00:13:42,560
Then, in exposure therapy,

00:13:42,640 --> 00:13:44,880
the person is in contact

00:13:44,960 --> 00:13:48,000

00:13:48,080 --> 00:13:49,840

277
00:13:50,440 --> 00:13:54,160

00:13:54,720 --> 00:13:57,600

00:13:59,080 --> 00:14:00,920

00:14:01,240 --> 00:14:03,240

00:14:03,320 --> 00:14:05,120

00:14:05,440 --> 00:14:07,000
And, from time to time, we come back here,

00:14:07,480 --> 00:14:09,160

00:14:09,240 --> 00:14:12,600

00:14:13,320 --> 00:14:16,040

288
00:14:17,800 --> 00:14:21,080
Later, I will
remember this situation again,

289
00:14:21,880 --> 00:14:24,800
but it will be another experience.  It

00:14:24,880 --> 00:14:30,200

my normal way of functioning.

00:14:30,920 --> 00:14:32,800
My mother, it must be a good task.  I

00:15:16,640 --> 00:15:19,360

309
00:15:19,880 --> 00:15:23,480

310
00:15:23,960 --> 00:15:26,760

311
00:15:26,840 --> 00:15:28,360

00:15:28,440 --> 00:15:31,240

00:15:31,320 --> 00:15:34,360

00:15:39,880 --> 00:15:42,240

00:15:42,320 --> 00:15:46,840

00:15:48,360 --> 00:15:50,520

00:15:51,720 --> 00:15:53,320

00:15:54,840 --> 00:15:57,680

00:15:57,760 --> 00:16:01,280

the body starts to say:

00:16:01,360 --> 00:16:03,240
"I'll lower the revs. There

00:16:03,320 --> 00:16:07,640

00:16:07,720 --> 00:16:11,080
so we bow our heads, we submit...

00:16:15,160 --> 00:16:18,960

00:16:19,040 --> 00:16:21,320

328
00:16:22,400 --> 00:16:23,960

329
00:16:24,960 --> 00:16:27,880

330
00:16:27,960 --> 00:16:30,880
In fact, if you are a herbivore, for example,

331
00:16:30,960 --> 00:16:32,440

00:16:38,720 --> 00:16:41,080

00:16:41,160 --> 00:16:42,680

336
00:16:42,760 --> 00:16:45,320

00:16:45,400 --> 00:16:48,000

338
00:16:48,080 --> 00:16:50,200
So, if the animal is in a state

339
00:16:50,280 --> 00:16:51,880
where it appears to be dead, it

340
00:16:52,480 --> 00:16:53,320

00:16:53,880 --> 00:16:58,280

342
00:16:58,360 --> 00:17:01,160

343
00:17:01,240 --> 00:17:03,160

00:17:03,240 --> 00:17:05,440

00:17:06,080 --> 00:17:08,200
People, for example,

00:17:08,520 --> 00:17:11,520

00:17:16,480 --> 00:17:17,760

00:17:17,840 --> 00:17:20,120

chance of winning.

00:17:20,520 --> 00:17:23,440

00:17:23,520 --> 00:17:25,800

which are passive responses,
emergency responses,

356
00:17:37,720 --> 00:17:41,200
those when there is nothing to do,
if they are repeated many times... We

00:17:41,280 --> 00:17:42,360
said that children

A girl

how children don't cry there, they

So, when you have lived

368
00:18:14,520 --> 00:18:16,400
only left with the other answers.

369
00:18:16,480 --> 00:18:18,400
And they are triggered so many times

370
00:18:18,760 --> 00:18:20,480
that later, when you become an adult,

371
00:18:20,560 --> 00:18:24,280
or if you have been in an abusive relationship,
for example,

372
00:18:24,360 --> 00:18:27,720
or in a
very problematic situation for a long time, you

373
00:18:28,600 --> 00:18:30,520
no longer know how to react
in any other way.

374
00:18:30,600 --> 00:18:33,000
When you could fight, you don't fight anymore.

375
00:18:33,080 --> 00:18:36,480
When you could walk away
from a problematic situation, you do

376
00:18:36,560 --> 00:18:37,560
n't.  We

377
00:18:38,280 --> 00:18:39,360
see this many times

378
00:18:39,440 --> 00:18:41,840
in situations
of domestic violence,

379
00:18:41,920 --> 00:18:45,560
which are people who, perhaps,
in their childhood stories, have

380
00:18:45,640 --> 00:18:47,680
had very complicated childhoods,

381
00:18:47,760 --> 00:18:50,880
and when they find themselves
in an abusive relationship, they

382
00:18:51,800 --> 00:18:52,720
don't get out of it.

383
00:18:53,680 --> 00:18:57,240
People sometimes look at them and say:
"But why didn't you leave earlier?".

384
00:18:57,560 --> 00:18:59,960
If you've been blocked since childhood,

385
00:19:00,400 --> 00:19:03,400
leaving is not easy at all.

386
00:19:03,480 --> 00:19:06,240
The body knows how to do it,

387
00:19:06,320 --> 00:19:08,000
but it's as if you've forgotten.

388
00:19:08,080 --> 00:19:12,640
You need to remember again
how to get out of a situation,

389
00:19:12,720 --> 00:19:16,880
that you can leave and that you can, sometimes,
fight for what you need.

390
00:19:17,480 --> 00:19:21,840
And when we talk about fear
and the situations that scare us,

391
00:19:22,400 --> 00:19:27,040
perhaps a very common
and very normal strategy would be to try to avoid them.

392
00:19:27,120 --> 00:19:29,200
That is, not confronting them.  Do you

393
00:19:29,280 --> 00:19:31,920
think these
fear avoidance strategies

394
00:19:32,000 --> 00:19:34,840
are good, are they healthy
or can they have consequences later?

395
00:19:34,920 --> 00:19:35,760
How do you see it?

396
00:19:35,840 --> 00:19:37,320
To avoid it would be to escape.

397
00:19:37,400 --> 00:19:41,120
If you are, for example,
with a partner who doesn't treat you well,

398
00:19:41,200 --> 00:19:43,840
avoiding this relationship
would be the best thing you can do.

399
00:19:44,840 --> 00:19:46,360
The problem is when we avoid things...

400
00:19:46,440 --> 00:19:49,200
Sometimes, we avoid things
that are good for us.

401
00:19:49,840 --> 00:19:51,040
Or we avoid everything,

402
00:19:51,120 --> 00:19:53,320
and this starts
to make our lives very complicated.

403
00:19:53,400 --> 00:19:55,680
All the mechanisms that the brain has,

404
00:19:55,760 --> 00:20:00,280
including what happens in phobias,
are fundamentally something that makes sense.

405
00:20:00,360 --> 00:20:02,600
It's the brain
putting itself in "just in case,"

406
00:20:02,680 --> 00:20:05,920
it's the brain associating things
that could be dangerous.  What

407
00:20:06,840 --> 00:20:10,960
happens is that,
sometimes, it slips out of our hands

408
00:20:11,040 --> 00:20:13,320
or sometimes it appears where it doesn't belong

409
00:20:13,760 --> 00:20:16,160
or stops being useful.

410
00:20:16,240 --> 00:20:20,440
But everything our mind does is
for a reason.

411
00:20:20,520 --> 00:20:23,680
Sometimes,
when we go back to the beginning,

412
00:20:23,760 --> 00:20:25,760
if I think: "I'm paralyzed,

413
00:20:25,840 --> 00:20:28,520
why am I paralyzed
at work with colleagues

414
00:20:28,600 --> 00:20:31,480
if I'm an adult,
I have resources?

415
00:20:31,560 --> 00:20:33,600
In other situations, I've been
able to manage it,

416
00:20:33,680 --> 00:20:34,840
and now why not?".

417
00:20:35,120 --> 00:20:37,800
Sometimes, the answer lies further back.

418
00:20:37,880 --> 00:20:39,040
If I think:

419
00:20:39,120 --> 00:20:42,160
"When was the first time I had
this feeling?",

420
00:20:42,480 --> 00:20:45,560
things certainly
make a lot more sense here.

421
00:20:46,120 --> 00:20:48,960
The thing is that this blockage has
stayed with me,

422
00:20:49,320 --> 00:20:52,960
and when something happens
that the brain connects with it,

423
00:20:53,040 --> 00:20:53,960
I get blocked again.

424
00:20:55,240 --> 00:20:57,560
And that's how the brain thinks
all the time.

425
00:20:57,640 --> 00:21:02,680
Me, if I'm in a meeting with you,
we're here talking,

426
00:21:02,760 --> 00:21:05,680
our brains are connecting
with other conversations,

427
00:21:05,760 --> 00:21:07,040
with other encounters..., we

428
00:21:07,120 --> 00:21:10,000
won't be constantly reinventing ourselves.

429
00:21:10,080 --> 00:21:14,080
But when the brain connects
with a blocking situation,

430
00:21:15,680 --> 00:21:16,680
then...

431
00:21:17,040 --> 00:21:18,440
If I reminded you of someone

432
00:21:18,520 --> 00:21:20,360
you had
a bad experience with,

433
00:21:20,440 --> 00:21:23,320
maybe right now you would be having
a strange feeling about me,

434
00:21:23,400 --> 00:21:25,600
and maybe it would have nothing to do with me.

435
00:21:25,680 --> 00:21:28,280
But the brain
is always associating things.  He

436
00:21:28,360 --> 00:21:29,760
does it for our good.

437
00:21:30,160 --> 00:21:32,080
But this
can sometimes backfire.

438
00:21:33,000 --> 00:21:34,680
"The brain does it for our good."

439
00:21:34,760 --> 00:21:36,640
I'll stick with this phrase, Anabel,

440
00:21:37,600 --> 00:21:40,320
because, besides,
when you're next to someone

441
00:21:40,400 --> 00:21:42,080
who happens to be afraid,

442
00:21:42,760 --> 00:21:45,240
the phrase always comes out:
"Stay calm"

443
00:21:45,320 --> 00:21:47,400
or "Stay calm",
"Don't be afraid".

444
00:21:47,480 --> 00:21:52,880
As if this phrase were magical
and could solve fear.

445
00:21:52,960 --> 00:21:55,800
These kinds of mantras, phrases,

446
00:21:55,880 --> 00:21:58,920
which often seem to
provoke even more reaction,

447
00:21:59,000 --> 00:22:00,280
is this a good mechanism?

448
00:22:00,360 --> 00:22:02,280
What should we do in these situations,

449
00:22:02,360 --> 00:22:04,480
when we are next to someone who
is suffering?

450
00:22:04,560 --> 00:22:09,480
Of course, telling someone who has anxiety,

451
00:22:09,560 --> 00:22:10,800
"Stay calm"

452
00:22:10,880 --> 00:22:13,640
is like telling someone
who has a wound, "Don't bleed."

453
00:22:14,120 --> 00:22:15,800
It's exactly the same.

454
00:22:15,880 --> 00:22:18,360
In fact, people who have anxiety,
when they are told this, get angry

455
00:22:18,440 --> 00:22:20,720
because they say:
"Of course, I would like it.

456
00:22:20,800 --> 00:22:23,640
That is exactly what
I would like at this moment."  It

457
00:22:24,440 --> 00:22:25,880
is true that the way

458
00:22:25,960 --> 00:22:29,480
we talk
to ourselves has an influence.

459
00:22:30,040 --> 00:22:32,000
In fact, people who have anxiety

460
00:22:32,400 --> 00:22:36,200
say things to themselves
that make them even more afraid.

461
00:22:36,280 --> 00:22:39,240
But, because the person
is saying these things to themselves, what

462
00:22:39,800 --> 00:22:44,920
they are told from the outside
doesn't get through.

463
00:22:45,240 --> 00:22:47,920
That's why we need to
do double the work.

464
00:22:48,000 --> 00:22:50,920
Learn to say things
to others that will help them.

465
00:22:51,000 --> 00:22:53,560
"Calm down" when he's
in an anxiety attack, no,

466
00:22:53,880 --> 00:22:54,880
but you can tell him,

467
00:22:54,960 --> 00:22:58,120
"I'm here. Do you
need anything? Can I help you?",

468
00:22:58,480 --> 00:23:00,040
which won't make him feel bad

469
00:23:00,120 --> 00:23:04,240
and we may not be able to perform miracles,
but it does help.

470
00:23:04,680 --> 00:23:07,800
And then the same person
can learn

471
00:23:08,320 --> 00:23:11,160
to see what things
can be said when it's wrong.

472
00:23:11,240 --> 00:23:12,920
In the midst of a crisis it is difficult,

473
00:23:13,000 --> 00:23:15,480
but afterwards
we can think a little.

474
00:23:15,880 --> 00:23:20,280
Above all, more than whatever calms us down
at that moment,

475
00:23:20,360 --> 00:23:24,560
which sometimes
means I need to see the doctor, have them

476
00:23:24,640 --> 00:23:25,800
give me something to lower it,

477
00:23:25,880 --> 00:23:27,880
and then we'll see
how we fix the issue,

478
00:23:28,160 --> 00:23:31,840
work on developing,
above all,

479
00:23:31,920 --> 00:23:36,640
the security that will make us
have less of this problem.

480
00:23:36,720 --> 00:23:41,800
The most important thing is to develop
what could prevent this fear

481
00:23:41,880 --> 00:23:46,160
and what can even help us get
through situations

482
00:23:46,240 --> 00:23:49,520
that can cause us fear,
which is to have a greater sense of security.

483
00:23:50,880 --> 00:23:54,720
Confidence does
n't mean you keep saying,

484
00:23:54,800 --> 00:23:57,680
in a higher-than-normal tone of voice,

485
00:23:57,760 --> 00:24:00,640
that you're very sure of what you're saying.
Quite the opposite.

486
00:24:00,720 --> 00:24:03,400
Security comes from reflection,

487
00:24:03,480 --> 00:24:06,880
from the ability to establish
relationships with others,

488
00:24:06,960 --> 00:24:08,440
from trust...

489
00:24:09,320 --> 00:24:11,200
Calm is fleeting.

490
00:24:12,000 --> 00:24:14,800
I can do something that calms me down
at a certain moment,

491
00:24:14,880 --> 00:24:17,880
but if the fear returns
shortly after, what do I do?

492
00:24:18,880 --> 00:24:23,120
People who are afraid
sometimes find small solutions

493
00:24:23,200 --> 00:24:26,200
that work in the short term,

494
00:24:26,280 --> 00:24:28,480
like avoidance, which you mentioned earlier.

495
00:24:28,560 --> 00:24:31,960
If I say: "I'm not going to this place,
it bothers me a bit,"

496
00:24:32,520 --> 00:24:34,520
then that's fine, but what if you have to go there?

497
00:24:34,600 --> 00:24:37,080
What if it
happens to you again later somewhere else?

498
00:24:37,880 --> 00:24:40,800
There are things that can be avoided,

499
00:24:40,880 --> 00:24:43,800
that solve the problem for the moment,
but that don't solve it later.

500
00:24:43,880 --> 00:24:47,360
On the other hand, security is something
that we can gradually grow

502
00:24:48,880 --> 00:24:52,800
until it helps us neutralize
fear a little

503
00:24:52,880 --> 00:24:55,720
and, even if we are afraid, we

504
00:24:56,960 --> 00:24:58,520
can do things.

505
00:24:58,600 --> 00:25:01,240
There are things we do
even though they scare us

506
00:25:01,320 --> 00:25:04,840
because we feel
that internal sense of security.

507
00:25:05,640 --> 00:25:09,560
Security comes about
spontaneously

508
00:25:09,880 --> 00:25:14,560
when you have grown up with people who have
given you protection and care.

509
00:25:15,320 --> 00:25:16,920
And when I say this, I always want to insist

510
00:25:17,000 --> 00:25:20,160
that we don't have to be perfect parents
and do everything right,

511
00:25:20,240 --> 00:25:21,880
because that is horrible

512
00:25:22,520 --> 00:25:24,720
for the safety of parents
and children.

513
00:25:25,040 --> 00:25:28,080
We have to do it as best we can, but be there.

514
00:25:29,120 --> 00:25:33,600
If I have a problem at school
or something happens to me with a friend

515
00:25:33,880 --> 00:25:36,280
or I'm worried about
something that's happening at home

516
00:25:36,640 --> 00:25:37,880
and someone notices it,

517
00:25:37,960 --> 00:25:41,280
and I know that
if I have a problem, I can explain it,

518
00:25:42,320 --> 00:25:44,800
I feel more confident, I

519
00:25:44,880 --> 00:25:46,440
feel more secure,

520
00:25:46,720 --> 00:25:49,880
I will feel that I can trust people.

521
00:25:50,880 --> 00:25:53,840
Thanks to this,
if difficult things happen, I

522
00:25:54,880 --> 00:25:57,560
won't be knocked down so easily.  We

523
00:25:57,640 --> 00:25:58,800
all have a limit

524
00:25:58,880 --> 00:26:00,800
and sometimes life
gets very complicated,

525
00:26:00,880 --> 00:26:04,360
but I have more capacity
to deal with things.

526
00:26:04,920 --> 00:26:06,240
Sometimes, life is very scary

527
00:26:06,320 --> 00:26:11,240
and you need to have that feeling of
security to get through it.

528
00:26:11,320 --> 00:26:12,120
Yes, yes.

529
00:26:12,200 --> 00:26:14,800
You said a phrase earlier
that drove me crazy, that

530
00:26:14,880 --> 00:26:16,880
"calm is fleeting."

531
00:26:17,240 --> 00:26:19,640
So, if the calm is fleeting,

532
00:26:19,720 --> 00:26:22,320
that means we will go through
stormy times.

533
00:26:22,760 --> 00:26:23,680
Yes.  Is there

534
00:26:24,360 --> 00:26:29,000
any way we can guarantee

535
00:26:29,080 --> 00:26:33,080
or at least reasonably mitigate
these moments of anguish

536
00:26:33,160 --> 00:26:36,800
and be able to have that security,
that confidence that you mention?

537
00:26:36,880 --> 00:26:40,840
Sure, but how does
a sailor know he's safe?

538
00:26:40,920 --> 00:26:43,560
Because he trusts
his abilities to do it,

539
00:26:43,640 --> 00:26:47,400
because he has sailed many seas
of many different types, he knows

540
00:26:47,480 --> 00:26:50,440
when to enter them and when not to, he

541
00:26:50,520 --> 00:26:52,880
knows when to return to port,
which is also something that needs to be known.  He has

542
00:26:53,280 --> 00:26:55,800
already been through a few storms,

543
00:26:55,880 --> 00:26:59,560
learned from each one
and continues to go sailing.

544
00:27:00,120 --> 00:27:03,800
If we keep doing things, from every mistake,

545
00:27:03,880 --> 00:27:06,880
from every thing that goes wrong,
we learn,

546
00:27:07,360 --> 00:27:10,880
and that is what makes us
feel that we have resources.  It's

547
00:27:12,480 --> 00:27:14,880
not that we don't have to be afraid of anything.

548
00:27:15,280 --> 00:27:18,120
If there is a huge storm, we should
not go out to sea.

549
00:27:18,200 --> 00:27:19,600
It's very clear.

550
00:27:19,960 --> 00:27:24,600
But I can feel
that I can handle many situations,

551
00:27:24,680 --> 00:27:27,720
that I can navigate seas of different kinds.

552
00:27:28,160 --> 00:27:32,320
And I feel like I can because I have
this feeling of security.

553
00:27:33,600 --> 00:27:37,800
Anabel, if the antidote
to fear is security,

554
00:27:37,880 --> 00:27:40,240
can we grow security?

555
00:27:40,320 --> 00:27:42,440
Is there any way to make it grow?

556
00:27:42,760 --> 00:27:45,360
Yes, but little by little.

557
00:27:45,720 --> 00:27:47,720
Security must be sown, it

558
00:27:47,800 --> 00:27:49,600
is something that grows little by little

559
00:27:49,680 --> 00:27:52,120
and that has a lot to do
not only with us,

560
00:27:52,200 --> 00:27:54,880
but it has a lot to do
with relationships.

561
00:27:55,480 --> 00:27:57,880
Sometimes
we try to solve a problem

562
00:27:57,960 --> 00:27:59,920
right where the problem is.  Let

563
00:28:00,880 --> 00:28:02,120
's try...

564
00:28:02,200 --> 00:28:04,680
I have a fever, I'll take something
to bring down my fever.

565
00:28:04,760 --> 00:28:08,720
It's okay, it has to be done.
But what caused my fever?

566
00:28:08,800 --> 00:28:11,120
Maybe it's an infection,
I need to take an antibiotic,

567
00:28:11,200 --> 00:28:13,800
but I'm getting a lot of infections.

568
00:28:13,880 --> 00:28:16,080
Shouldn't I strengthen my
immune system?

569
00:28:16,480 --> 00:28:17,760
Growing security

570
00:28:17,840 --> 00:28:21,280
is like strengthening
the emotional immune system

571
00:28:22,400 --> 00:28:25,560
and is not so directly related
to what scares us, it

572
00:28:25,640 --> 00:28:27,080
is background work.

573
00:28:27,400 --> 00:28:29,240
For example, we said reflection.

574
00:28:29,560 --> 00:28:33,880
Reflection is like state-of-the-art software

575
00:28:34,720 --> 00:28:37,880
that makes everything that happens,
whether it goes well or badly, give

576
00:28:37,960 --> 00:28:42,240
me more and more tools,
more and more resources.

577
00:28:42,600 --> 00:28:44,160
I understand things better and better.  There

578
00:28:44,240 --> 00:28:45,600
are still many things I don't understand, I

579
00:28:45,680 --> 00:28:48,800
ask myself many questions
and feel very curious.

580
00:28:48,880 --> 00:28:51,800
Curiosity
also increases security.

581
00:28:52,360 --> 00:28:54,040
What Murakami said:

582
00:28:54,440 --> 00:28:59,280
"Safety has a lot to do
with curiosity and courage."

583
00:28:59,360 --> 00:29:03,880
He was talking, specifically, about curiosity
and courage, which went together.

584
00:29:03,960 --> 00:29:08,040
Really, if you think about it,
a child feels curious

585
00:29:08,480 --> 00:29:10,440
and this moves them
to do things that scare them,

586
00:29:10,520 --> 00:29:13,920
but, because they are more curious
than afraid, they manage to do it.

587
00:29:14,320 --> 00:29:17,920
Another thing that also increases
security is trust.

588
00:29:18,800 --> 00:29:22,040
And this is complicated
because if we come, for example,

589
00:29:22,120 --> 00:29:25,760
from stories of betrayal or stories
of very difficult relationships, let's

590
00:29:26,360 --> 00:29:29,360
see who the handsome one is who trusts.  It

591
00:29:29,440 --> 00:29:32,280
's not easy,
but you need to regain your confidence

592
00:29:32,360 --> 00:29:33,880
because, if not, there's no chance.

593
00:29:34,640 --> 00:29:35,800
A person who distrusts

594
00:29:35,880 --> 00:29:37,840
is a person
who is placed inside a bunker

595
00:29:38,160 --> 00:29:39,520
and, inside that bunker, you

596
00:29:40,880 --> 00:29:42,520
may think that they won't hurt you,

597
00:29:42,600 --> 00:29:45,960
but inside you ca
n't really feel safe.  We

598
00:29:46,440 --> 00:29:49,240
feel safe when we walk down the street

599
00:29:49,640 --> 00:29:52,760
and approach people,
we understand them,

600
00:29:52,840 --> 00:29:56,680
when we connect with someone,
when we learn about things...

601
00:29:56,760 --> 00:29:59,960
We need to explore
to feel safe.

602
00:30:00,440 --> 00:30:02,320
How will we feel safe driving

603
00:30:02,400 --> 00:30:05,040
if we always have our car in the parking lot?  It ca

604
00:30:05,720 --> 00:30:06,880
n't be.

605
00:30:07,160 --> 00:30:10,400
Then, trust, curiosity,

606
00:30:10,920 --> 00:30:13,880
reflection, exploration

607
00:30:14,480 --> 00:30:16,080
and looking inside ourselves too,

608
00:30:16,160 --> 00:30:19,200
because exploration is not only
about what happens outside,

609
00:30:19,280 --> 00:30:21,880
but also about what
happens inside us

610
00:30:22,320 --> 00:30:24,240
and what happens inside the rest.

611
00:30:24,560 --> 00:30:27,560
A very interesting thing
to do to be able to reflect better

612
00:30:27,640 --> 00:30:28,480
is to listen.  It

613
00:30:29,080 --> 00:30:33,280
's not a very common sport, is it?

614
00:30:33,360 --> 00:30:37,880
Because, sometimes, what
we do is have monologues for two.

615
00:30:38,200 --> 00:30:40,560
Or, sometimes, when we talk to someone,

616
00:30:40,640 --> 00:30:42,880
we are more busy
preparing an answer

really have this function,

866
00:43:25,800 --> 00:43:27,600
each one their own.

867
00:43:28,240 --> 00:43:30,760
If we
don't follow the rules of the game,

868
00:43:30,840 --> 00:43:33,720
so to speak,
trying to avoid...

869
00:43:34,840 --> 00:43:37,680
I can't help but feel afraid, it

870
00:43:37,760 --> 00:43:39,920
would be like saying:
"I want to avoid having lungs."

871
00:43:40,000 --> 00:43:41,560
Well, I can't.

872
00:43:41,840 --> 00:43:44,640
Every emotion has a function,
they all have meaning.

873
00:43:44,960 --> 00:43:47,840
So, trying to avoid them,
trying to control them...

874
00:43:47,920 --> 00:43:49,440
If I try to control an emotion

875
00:43:49,520 --> 00:43:51,840
it's like trying to hold a cat very tightly.

876
00:43:53,280 --> 00:43:54,280
Things will happen,

877
00:43:54,360 --> 00:43:57,200
but they probably
won't be very convenient.  There

878
00:43:57,280 --> 00:43:59,360
are times when we don't even realize

879
00:43:59,440 --> 00:44:01,040
that emotions are there.

880
00:44:01,120 --> 00:44:04,440
Another word
that we use is "alexithymia",

881
00:44:04,520 --> 00:44:08,280
which describes people
who don't have an emotional vocabulary,

882
00:44:08,360 --> 00:44:09,400
who don't realize...

883
00:44:09,480 --> 00:44:12,520
Emotions are
something very confusing for them

884
00:44:12,600 --> 00:44:14,760
or they wouldn't even know how to define them.

885
00:44:14,840 --> 00:44:17,680
These people
tend to somatize much more,

886
00:44:18,040 --> 00:44:21,200
to express through the body,
because through the emotional aspect

887
00:44:21,280 --> 00:44:23,800
they are not able to explain to someone:
"I am bad",

888
00:44:23,880 --> 00:44:26,160
because they would not know what to say.

889
00:44:26,840 --> 00:44:28,560
Then, poor emotional management

890
00:44:29,720 --> 00:44:31,160
is very unprofitable

891
00:44:31,240 --> 00:44:34,640
because it causes emotions to get stuck,
blocked.

892
00:44:34,720 --> 00:44:37,560
For example,
if I control them or suppress them,

893
00:44:37,640 --> 00:44:39,320
which sometimes we
push so much down

894
00:44:39,400 --> 00:44:41,760
